description: Header file defining the HttpDecoder class for decoding HTTP frames over QUIC, including nested classes, visitor interface, and parsing methods.

classes.name: HttpDecoder
classes.description: Class for decoding HTTP frames exchanged in HTTP over QUIC sessions, with nested Options and Visitor classes.

classes.name: HttpDecoder::Options
classes.description: Configuration options for HttpDecoder, such as allowing WEBTRANSPORT_STREAM parsing.

classes.name: HttpDecoder::Visitor
classes.description: Interface for handling parsed frames and errors during HTTP decoding.

methods.name: ProcessInput
methods.description: Processes input data, invoking visitor methods until completion or error.

methods.name: DecodeSettings
methods.description: Decodes a settings frame from raw data into a SettingsFrame object.
